channel.title: Hull What's On - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Hull What's On (hullwhatson.com)

item.title: Second section of Hull Nature Trail opens at Oak Road Playing Fields
item.description: The second section of the Hull Nature Trail has opened at Oak Road Playing Fields, offering accessible routes, wildlife and green space for residents to explore.

item.title: Council seeks partner to develop cultural plan for young people
item.description: Hull City Council is seeking a partner to develop a Children and Young People’s Culture and Heritage Plan to support wellbeing, learning and creative opportunities.

item.title: Council continues to improve safety with new crossing facilities announced for Maybury Road
item.description: Hull City Council will install a new toucan crossing on Maybury Road to improve safety and support walking and cycling near Holderness Drain.

item.title: New SEND facility at The Boulevard Academy
item.description: A new SEND unit has opened at The Boulevard Academy in Hull, providing specialist support for students with additional needs alongside mainstream education.

item.title: Footpath improvement programme announced for 18 streets across Hull
item.description: Hull City Council has announced a footpath improvement programme covering 18 streets and a park, using slurry sealing to enhance safety and extend surface life.

item.title: Powering up for Chamber Expo ’26! ‘Early Bird’ £249 stand deals available now as bookings open!
item.description: Bookings are now open for Chamber Expo 2026 in Hull, with early bird stands available from £249 and a focus on energy, power and connectivity.

item.title: Lib Dem Councillor launches petition to save Lloyds bank branch on Ings Road, Sutton ward
item.description: A Hull councillor has launched a petition to save the Lloyds bank branch on Ings Road, warning of the impact on elderly and vulnerable residents.

item.title: Be part of the maritime story and become a volunteer to share the city’s seafaring past
item.description: Hull Maritime is recruiting volunteers to help share the city’s seafaring history across key attractions including the Arctic Corsair and Spurn Lightship.

item.title: Thrive Hull Conference spotlights mental health support for young people
item.description: More than 350 professionals, youth workers, educators and healthcare leaders gathered in Hull on Thursday 19 March for the Thrive Hull Conference 2026: Thriving Minds – Supporting Mental Health for Children and Young People in Hull. item.title: Hull’s A63 is finally open – here’s what happens next
item.description: After several years of construction work, the major upgrade to the A63 at Castle Street is nearing completion, with the new underpass at Mytongate already open to traffic.
